question: Can a fixed small-prime ideal dictionary give exact dual ideal witnesses for the strict unramified character blocks, and separate the generic contribution?
selection: The three cases with complete bad-place coverage in rank_jump_strict_class_blocks_v1.json. Candidate ideals use only the integral cubic and its discriminant: all degree-one ideals over odd rational primes at most 97 not dividing the integral-model discriminant, sorted by prime then root.
diagnostic: After freezing the ideal pool, evaluate the existing strict characters by Frobenius and compute a dual basis. Character construction and independence still use retrospective exceptional points; the resulting ranks are not point-blind measurements.
positive: A full-row-rank Artin matrix yields explicit independent classes in Cl(O_K,S)/2 and exact ideal words dual to the generic and relative character basis.
negative: A deficient matrix means this fixed prime dictionary does not separate all retained characters. It does not reduce their proven global independence or exclude smaller/other ideal generators.
replay: Retain ideal prime/root labels, complete evaluation matrix, generic/relative character masks, and dual ideal words. Independently check local square tests by PARI; no global class group.
